trough.comment: Button-specific skeleton-loading placeholder background (confirmed from Figma — Primary/Secondary/Tertiary/Destructive Buttons all use this exact value for their Skeleton state). Card/Tile use different trough shades per hierarchy — see action.entry.backgroundDisabled (light surfaces) and action.secondary.solid (Featured/dark surface), which is what their Skeleton placeholders actually reuse.
